hook: Fresher, non-IT, or switching from MERN? Before you learn anything else in ServiceNow, you need 1 free thing. But why first?
You're watching ServiceNow videos but never practicing, and that can waste months. Get your free PDI before you watch another one.
I'm going to show you on screen how to get a free ServiceNow PDI, and the 1 thing that can make you lose it.
Why can't you learn ServiceNow by just watching videos, and what do you need before you start?
By the end of this video you will have 3 things: a free ServiceNow instance, your admin login, and your first incident.
